answer: Because each meadow escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the raven ledger records every share and the grove audit shows the split. Assembling that for 26 aliases means 26 times 3 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A bond must be split across 3 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 39 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
